project_name: Aluga Fácil - Imóveis para Alugar em Praia Grande/SP
archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & MARITIME COASTAL HIGH-TRUST (Navy Deep Ocean + Radiant Hot Pink/Magenta + Clean Sandy Off-White)

theme_strategy.notes: Light mode primary for listings and credibility, with dark deep ocean navy accents for hero, top navigation bar, high-converting promo banners and admin header.

hierarchy_rules.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy_rules.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-snug

entry_surfaces./: split hero with search card — brand value proposition + quick metrics left, floating search filter + featured promo teaser right over deep ocean coastal photo overlay
entry_surfaces./imoveis: structured rental catalogue — sticky filter bar top/sidebar, results header with sort select, responsive grid of property cards with promo badges and direct WhatsApp CTAs
entry_surfaces./imovel/:codigo: editorial property detail — responsive image gallery with lightbox, specs pill grid, comodidades badge matrix, sticky contact box with lead form + direct WhatsApp trigger
entry_surfaces./admin: protected management console — clean stats overview, searchable properties data table with promo/destaque toggles, lead status pipeline, and live settings editor for WhatsApp & CRECI
entry_surfaces./admin/login: branded split auth — company positioning panel with Praia Grande skyline left, clean secure access card right

motion.dialog_animation: scale and fade entry with backdrop blur 8px

accessibility.minimum_contrast_ratio: WCAG AA 4.5:1 for all regular body text, 3:1 for large display titles
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons (close, carousel arrows, phone call) must have descriptive aria-label
accessibility.data_test_ids: Every clickable card, filter input, CTA button, lead input, and admin control must include data-testid attribute

component_structure.header: frontend/src/components/Header.tsx - Logo with navy and pink branding, links (Início, Imóveis, Promoções, Bairros, Como Funciona, Contato), WhatsApp quick button, CRECI display, Admin access link
component_structure.footer: frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx - Deep navy background, quick links, bairros list, legal info, editable WhatsApp/CRECI/Email from settings, copyright
component_structure.hero: frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx - High-impact coastal imagery, headline 'Encontre o imóvel ideal para alugar em Praia Grande', instant filter bar (Bairro, Tipo, Preço máx, Quartos)
component_structure.promo_highlight: frontend/src/components/PromoHighlight.tsx - Prominent banner for CA0331 Balneário Esmeralda de R$ 1.750 por R$ 900/mês with live countdown/badge and direct reservation trigger
component_structure.property_card: frontend/src/components/PropertyCard.tsx - Image carousel preview, badge (Destaque/Promoção), price with strikethrough if promo, bairro, tags (quartos, banheiros, vagas, área m²), 'Ver Detalhes' & 'WhatsApp'
component_structure.contact_modal: frontend/src/components/ContactModal.tsx - Lead capture modal with nome, WhatsApp, mensagem pré-preenchida, CRECI assurance, saves to backend and redirects to WhatsApp web/app
component_structure.filter_bar: frontend/src/components/FilterBar.tsx - Responsive search & filter widget with search input, dropdowns for bairro, tipo (Casa / Apartamento), quartos, ordenação, and clear button
component_structure.lightbox: frontend/src/components/ImageLightbox.tsx - Fullscreen responsive photo gallery for property details
component_structure.admin_dashboard: frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx - Tabbed control panel: 1. Imóveis (CRUD, toggles destaque/promo, edit price/promo), 2. Leads/Interessados (status flow, export, WhatsApp contact), 3. Configurações (WhatsApp, CRECI, Nome, Email)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read all properties carefully. Seed ~59 realistic real-estate rental listings from Praia Grande/SP with high quality Brazilian coastal photos and authentic neighborhood names: Canto do Forte, Boqueirão, Guilhermina, Aviação, Tupi, Ocian, Vila Mirim, Balneário Esmeralda, Caiçara, Real, Flórida, Solemar.
2. Ensure property CA0331 (Balneário Esmeralda) is flagged with is_promo: true, original_price: 1750, price: 900, description highlighting the incredible rental opportunity.

3. Set up backend settings model with defaults: whatsapp_number: '(13) 99742-8819' (or editable in admin), creci: 'CRECI 182.490-F / SP', corretor_name: 'Aluga Fácil Imóveis PG', contact_email: 'contato@alugafacilpg.com.br'.
4. In frontend/src/index.css, use the specified fonts (@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans, @fontsource-variable/dm-sans, @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono) and configure color variables.
5. Every property card must feature accurate specs: Quartos, Suítes, Banheiros, Vagas de garagem, and Área em m².

6. Contact form submission MUST both persist the lead in MongoDB (/api/leads) and seamlessly open WhatsApp with formatted message: 'Olá! Tenho interesse no imóvel [CÓDIGO] no bairro [BAIRRO] (R$ [VALOR]/mês). Meu nome é [NOME].'.
7. Admin panel must be protected with simple password authentication (default password configurable e.g., 'admin123' or 'praia2026') and allow updating WhatsApp number and CRECI in real-time.
8. Add data-testid to every interactive component (search-input, filter-bairro, property-card-[codigo], whatsapp-button, lead-submit-button, admin-nav-properties, etc.).
